production_safety.operational_data: Production read-only reproduction confirmed an email rejection and that the user-supplied receipt exists. QA submitted synthetic records and verified their private DB/admin representation. No real user inquiry was modified or deleted before commit.
production_safety.schema_migration: None: optional contact/contactType properties are added to JSON for new intake; prior rows use contact/phone/email fallbacks.
external_side_effects: A deliberately rejected synthetic email request reproduced the live bug; it created no intake and sent no email.
Synthetic QA real-browser submits and authenticated CMS checks use isolated localhost DB and closed SMTP.
AWS deployment and a clearly identified real-browser production verification are planned after commit; check that notification recipients remain empty before any successful production test.

verification.command: pnpm --filter korea typecheck; pnpm --filter admin typecheck; production builds
verification.evidence: TypeScript and final Korea/admin standalone builds pass. Later public runtime-only edits are served/copied as static files and syntax-checked.

Three real browser submissions: mobile email, additional phone and desktop careers. Invalid contact stays inline with input preserved; successful form is hidden/cleared and whole confirmation card is in viewport. Screenshots under output/korea-inquiry-e2e.

verification.command: Synthetic QA DB and authenticated CMS receipt verification
verification.evidence: Three actual browser receipt references stored correct email/phone/formType/consent and appeared in permission-guarded CMS HTML.

verification.command: node --check apps/korea/public/korea-runtime.js; python -m py_compile apps/korea/tests/inquiry.e2e.py; git diff --check
verification.evidence: Runtime JS/Python syntax and patch whitespace checks pass.

residual_risks: Email input validation checks format, not mailbox existence or delivery. External notification SMTP configuration is unchanged.
Browser pages already open before deployment need refresh to display the new completion card.
Network loss after persistence can leave the client unsure of the receipt; simultaneous-click duplication is blocked but cross-reload idempotency is not introduced in this fix.
